source_review.notes: Reviewed Ukkonen's primary online-construction paper, Carnegie Mellon and Stanford suffix-tree materials, maintained LLVM and Rust implementations, Princeton/CMU suffix-array foundations, and the NIST definition. All eight final destinations returned HTTP 200. A case-sensitive stale NIST path returning 404 was corrected before review.

evidence: Checked indexed text T, suffix S_i, half-open edge labels, string depth, explicit/implicit loci, leaf starts, occurrence sets, phases, active point, remainder, and open ends.
Checked edge interval start, suffix start, suffix rank, text coordinate, node identity, suffix-link target, construction pointer, and immutable generation remain distinct.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Sentinel-inclusive indexed length and original user-text length are separated throughout.

evidence: Recomputed banana$ seven leaves, three nonroot internal nodes plus root, and eleven total nodes.
Recomputed visible root labels $,a,banana$,na; ana positions 1,3; nan position 2; banana position 0; and absent xyz.
Recomputed deepest internal path ana and lexicographic leaf SA 6,5,3,1,0,4,2.
Recomputed aba$ exercise topology and SA 3,2,0,1.
Checked node bound n leaves plus at most n-1 internals gives at most 2n-1.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The first hand count of ten nodes was contradicted by executable traversal and corrected to eleven before review.

evidence: Verified contracting nonterminal unary suffix-trie paths preserves every root-to-leaf suffix and sentinel gives one leaf per suffix.
Derived the linear node bound from internal degree and tree edge count while separating copied-label symbol cost.
Verified pattern consumption may finish at a node or inside an edge and descendant leaves are exactly overlapping occurrence starts.
Verified ordered leaf traversal yields SA, suffix-pair LCP is LCA string depth, and deepest internal paths represent repeats.
Reviewed Ukkonen's linear-time claim conditionally on active point, suffix links, Rule 3, skip/count, shared leaf ends, and transition costs.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The naïve builder is explicitly a correctness oracle without a linear-time claim.

evidence: Reviewed sentinel-only, one/all-equal/all-distinct/periodic texts, suffix-prefix cases, split mismatch positions, and patterns empty/absent/full/inside-edge/at-node/overlapping/sentinel/boundary.

Reviewed endpoint and suffix-start confusion, shared leaf ends, active-length normalization, root fallback, suffix-link targets, off-by-one conventions, allocation/split failure, and parent/depth metadata.

Reviewed malformed cycles/shared ownership/intervals/sibling symbols/leaf permutations, repetitive denial of service, output amplification, cross-document matches, partial publication, stale generations, and reclaimed mapped text.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Bounds cover text, nodes, edge intervals, depth, traversal, occurrence output, construction state, mapped regions, and diagnostics.

evidence: The executable checks unique node reachability, leaf childlessness, nonroot internal degree at least two, nonempty labels, and first-symbol child indexing.
It reconstructs every root-to-leaf suffix and compares the exact suffix multiset and leaf-start permutation.
It reproduces query completion at nodes and inside edges, deepest internal path, node/leaf counts, and suffix-array leaf order.
invariant_checking.notes: The finite implementation stores owned label strings and does not validate interval, suffix-link, active-point, concurrency, or persistent formats.

evidence: Reviewed text/sentinel/multi-document identity, compact topology, node bound, naïve split construction and failure semantics, search, SA/LCP/repeat relations, and suffix links.
Reviewed Ukkonen phase/extension mechanics, Rule 3, skip/count, shared leaf ends, SA+LCP construction alternative, and concrete pointer/index/flattened layouts.
Reviewed immutable generation concurrency, persistence/semantic validation/crash publication, security/resource controls, phase-by-phase oracle evidence, faults, and representative benchmarks.
proof_review.notes: No production implementation is validated merely by matching Ukkonen vocabulary.

evidence: Compact-trie equivalence, degree count, search, SA/LCP, and construction obligations are labeled separately.
Ukkonen's theorem is attributed to the primary paper; maintained implementations and academic explanations are named sources.
The finite naïve trace is explicitly not presented as online linear-time or production evidence.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Practical suffix-array superiority or suffix-tree query superiority is never claimed independent of workload/layout.

evidence: The standard-library-only Python trace passed exact twelve-line stdout, empty stderr, and zero exit status under the recorded Python toolchain.
It emits evidence=finite_suffix_tree_trace and reproduces suffix insertion, compression, node/leaf counts, implicit/node searches, repeat, SA, and structural validation.
All eight final external destinations returned HTTP 200 and repository-local links passed module validation.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No Ukkonen phases, interval storage, Unicode coordinates, allocation failure, concurrency, persistence, hostile parser, production memory/cache/NUMA/tail workload was empirically evaluated.

conceptual_review.notes: Progresses from compact suffix-trie semantics through search and SA/LCP relationships, naïve versus Ukkonen/SA-based construction, layout, concurrency, persistence, security, and evidence.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed sentinel/separator and coordinate contracts, interval versus suffix-start ownership, child layout and concrete bytes, peak build memory, library-versus-owned algorithm choice, atomic immutable publication, flattened leaf ranges, mapped semantic validation, provenance/access control, output pagination, crash replacement, and workload telemetry.

pedagogical_review.notes: Builds on prior trie/suffix-array modules, distinguishes linear-size output from linear-time construction, corrects an evidence-discovered node count, includes ten examples, and five progressive exercises with complete answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary/official-source, mathematical, executable-snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external academic, Ukkonen, Carnegie Mellon, Stanford, LLVM, Rust, Princeton, NIST, Unicode, security, performance, reliability, operations, architecture, or independent practitioner review is claimed. The chapter and finite trace prove neither Ukkonen/SA-to-tree production correctness or linearity, arbitrary text/canonicalization/multi-document semantics, fixed-width/allocation/failure safety, suffix-link/active-point correctness, stable handles, thread safety/linearizability, safe reclamation, durable persistence/crash recovery, hostile-parser security, production memory/cache/NUMA/tail behavior, certification, nor deployment fitness.
